description: A recreational running club that meets weekly for group runs and uses a WhatsApp group to coordinate routes, times, and social events. Members range from competitive runners to casual joggers. Interactions are mostly run logistics with social overflow.

personas.background: Has led the club for three years. Energetic, upbeat, keeps everyone on track. Knows who needs pace accommodations and who wants to push hard. Former track athlete.
